Independently compiled C++ program enumerated this complete finite space, obtained 0,0,0,2880 and 12 symmetry canonical keys with orbit sizes 240; rank split 1920 and 960. The original source verify.cpp also rechecks congruence generation and pair compressibility. The exclusion of two-permutation-letter cases and input interchange was observed; no extrapolation to larger n.
